start: fresh Pyrelands map in ordinary play, opening front lit (asserted: ProbeOpeningFront done, lit > 0)
colony vitals and pending incidents recorded
scenes.action: watch the front for a game day, then let it die down and wait out the smoulder window
scenes.expect: a contiguous front whose centroid moves, a growing scorched trail, and a relight in open grass beyond the building margin after it dies

control.case: the same seed with the burn line switch off
control.expect: no front walks and no relight comes in the same window
control.rules_out: a vanilla wildfire incident or a test-lit fire passing for the burn line

scenes.restore: put back the pad terrain, plants, filth and things from the snapshot taken at scene-begin, extinguish every fire the scene lit, restore the burn line switch and weather; the map itself is a disposable quicktest map and is destroyed after

start: fresh Pyrelands map, clear weather at noon (asserted)
scenes.action: census the terrain; capture open ground; force ash fall for half a day, counting loose ash and reading light each hour
scenes.expect: deep ash on most cells, soil and gravel only in pockets, richer ground by water; ash blowing in clear weather; drifts rise and the light falls under ash fall

control.case: a vanilla arid shrubland quicktest map read by the same census and capture
control.expect: no deep ash and no blowing ash
control.rules_out: a map-wide overlay or terrain relabel applied whatever the biome

scenes.restore: destroy the vanilla control map; on the Pyrelands map remove the loose ash laid by the forced ash fall and restore the weather chooser

start: two deep-ash strips of the same size, one beside a watered channel (asserted: terrain on both strips reads RM_FE_Ash_Deep, wet read on one)
same crop sown on the same tick
scenes.action: grow five days, reading growth each day
scenes.expect: the watered strip clearly ahead; fertility about 140% watered and about 40% dry

control.case: the same watered deep-ash strip with the watered-lift switch (ashWaterFertilityEnabled) off, sown on the same tick
control.expect: reads dry-ash fertility (about 40%) and grows at the dry strip's rate
control.rules_out: richer soil by the water passing for watered ash: the lift is the mechanism, not the ground

scenes.restore: put back the pad terrain, plants, filth and things from the snapshot taken at scene-begin, extinguish every fire the scene lit (both strips and the channel), restore the watered-lift switch

start: three deep-ash pads: fresh burn, fresh burn under black rain, old ash under black rain (asserted by the ash fertility probe)
scenes.action: start black rain over two pads for half a day; read the probe and crop growth on each through day 7
scenes.expect: wet fresh scar about 190%, dry fresh scar about 90%, wet old ash about 140% while it rains; the burn bonus gone by day 6 to 7 on its own clock

control.case: the same three pads with the burn bonus switch off
control.expect: the wet fresh scar reads the same as wet old ash
control.rules_out: rain watering alone passing for the compound

scenes.restore: put back the pad terrain, plants, filth and things from the snapshot taken at scene-begin, extinguish every fire the scene lit (three pads), restore the weather and the burn bonus switch

start: a burned ember-grass patch on deep ash at the biome's heat (asserted: share green near 0 after the burn)
vitals and incident guard before and after each wait
scenes.action: count green cells and capture on days 1, 3 and 7; census grass cover on open ground
scenes.expect: at least 25% green on day 3, at least 60% on day 7; dense cover on open ground

control.case: the same patch with ember-grass regrow switched off
control.expect: stays black through day 7
control.rules_out: the test or the density enforcer re-sowing the patch

scenes.restore: put back the pad terrain, plants, filth and things from the snapshot taken at scene-begin, extinguish every fire the scene lit (the patch), restore the regrow switch

start: map-wide scorch-fruit count 0 (asserted)
a freshly burned pad and an unburned pad of the same ground and age
scenes.action: burn the pad and read scorch-fruit on it during and just after the burn; ripen one; a colonist harvests it and a hungry colonist eats; leave a ripe plant and a stack in the open
scenes.expect: fruit only on the burned pad, standing in the scar within the burn itself rather than days later; harvest feeds; the plant withers within a day and the stack rots within four

control.case: the unburned pad
control.expect: shows 0 scorch-fruit
control.rules_out: scorch-fruit placed by the test or growing as wild flora

scenes.restore: put back the pad terrain, plants, filth and things from the snapshot taken at scene-begin, extinguish every fire the scene lit (both pads), remove every scorch-fruit plant and stack, restore the colonists' food need

start: fresh Pyrelands map on the composed mandrake.rm.biomes list, log tap open from generation
scenes.action: census every wild plant and animal on the map against the biome manifest; read the log
scenes.expect: every defName in the manifest, grazers outnumber predators, no red error

control.case: one donor plant and one donor animal spawned before the census
control.expect: both are reported as intruders
control.rules_out: a census that cannot see intruders reporting a clean map

scenes.restore: despawn the two seeded intruders; nothing else is changed

start: fresh Pyrelands map holding ruins (asserted: at least one)
scenes.action: capture each ruin at play zoom; read footprint terrain and filth
scenes.expect: blackened ruins on deep ash with loose ash in them

control.case: a ruin on a vanilla temperate quicktest map read the same way
control.expect: reads clean, on soil
control.rules_out: ruin art that is always scorched whatever the biome

scenes.restore: destroy the vanilla control map; the Pyrelands map is read only

start: grass pad with a fire at one end and no fire ahead of it (asserted)
one fire-hawk on the pad; flight is not watched, only state read
scenes.action: read the hawk's job and carried thing each window until it drops
scenes.expect: carry, then drop, then a fire at the drop cell beyond the front before the front reaches it

control.case: the same pad and fire with no hawk
control.expect: no fire at that cell in the same window
control.rules_out: ordinary fire spread lighting the drop cell

scenes.restore: put back the pad terrain, plants, filth and things from the snapshot taken at scene-begin, extinguish every fire the scene lit, despawn the test hawk

start: a colonist beside a furnace-beast in the open
two identical closed rooms at the same temperature, one holding a furnace-beast (asserted)
scenes.action: walk the colonist ten cells away; read room temperatures each hour
scenes.expect: warmth status beside the beast and gone away from it; the beast's room clearly hotter

control.case: the twin room without the beast
control.expect: stays at the starting temperature
control.rules_out: outside heat or the burn line warming the room

scenes.restore: despawn the beast and remove the two test rooms from the snapshot; restore the colonist's position and the room temperatures' map

start: an ashwallow on a grass pad, health recorded
a fire front driven over its cell
scenes.action: read status and health before, during and after the front
scenes.expect: burrowed status while the front is on its cell, health unchanged after

control.case: the same animal and front with the burrow switch off
control.expect: takes burn damage
control.rules_out: the fire simply missing the animal

scenes.restore: put back the pad terrain, plants, filth and things from the snapshot taken at scene-begin, extinguish every fire the scene lit, despawn the ashwallow, restore the burrow switch

start: two burned pads, one two days old and one an hour old, an ullai herd equidistant (asserted by burn history)
scenes.action: read the herd centroid each game hour for a day
scenes.expect: the herd drifts to the two-day-old pad

control.case: the same layout with no burn history
control.expect: no drift toward either pad
control.rules_out: a herd that wanders at random passing a scar

scenes.restore: put back the pad terrain, plants, filth and things from the snapshot taken at scene-begin, extinguish every fire the scene lit (both pads), despawn the herd, clear the test burn history from the burn line record

start: the same map at noon, clear weather asserted
three fire pads lit and burning (asserted)
a loose-ash patch laid and counted
scenes.action: force ash fall, cinderfall and black rain in turn, half a day each, over one fire pad and the ash patch; capture each at play zoom for a blind reader; count lightning strikes under each sky; count fire cells and loose ash each hour; keep one fire pad under clear sky and force vanilla rain over the third
scenes.expect: the three captures are told apart and from vanilla rain; lightning strikes under cinderfall and none under ash fall; loose ash falls under black rain; fires go out under black rain while the clear-sky pad still burns

control.case: the clear-sky fire pad and the vanilla-rain fire pad over the same hours, and a vanilla rain capture shown to the blind reader
control.expect: the clear-sky pad keeps burning; the vanilla-rain pad also goes out; the reader names the vanilla capture ordinary rain
control.rules_out: fires dying on their own being read as black rain's doing, and a reader that names every dark sky black rain; fire-out under black rain is vanilla rain's own rule carried by black rain, and the claim is no more than that

scenes.restore: put back the pad terrain, plants, filth and things from the snapshot taken at scene-begin, extinguish every fire the scene lit, restore the weather chooser to its prior weather and clear the loose ash the scene laid

start: the Pyrelands map; weather chooser running normally
scenes.action: read the biome's weather list and the weathers chosen over a compressed season
scenes.expect: no ordinary rain listed or chosen

control.case: the same reader on a vanilla temperate map
control.expect: reports ordinary rain chosen
control.rules_out: a weather reader that never sees rain at all

scenes.restore: the compressed season cannot be put back cell by cell: the scene runs on a disposable quicktest map made for it, saved at scene-begin, and destroyed at the end; nothing else is touched

start: clear weather asserted and held for the whole scene (no rain, black rain or cinderfall)
a grass bed both sides of a two-cell flagstone strip (asserted by terrain read)
RM_FE_FirebreakLine absent from the defs
scenes.action: drive the front at the strip and keep it burning at the near edge for an hour; let the near side die and relight a smoulder on the near side next to the strip (TryReseedStandingBurn); drop a hawk ember on the paving; then let a hawk carry one six cells past
scenes.expect: while fire burns at the near edge, no fire on the far side; the near-side relight does not cross; the ember on paving lights nothing; the six-cell carry lights the far side (the sprayer's job, not the strip's)

control.case: the same bed in the same clear weather with no strip
control.expect: the front burns through to the far side
control.rules_out: weather, burn-out or the test putting the fire out before it reached the strip: the start asserts clear weather and fire still burning at the strip edge

scenes.restore: put back the pad terrain, plants, filth and things from the snapshot taken at scene-begin, extinguish every fire the scene lit (the bed and the strip), despawn the hawk, restore the weather

start: fresh Pyrelands map on his full list, a paved ring round the colony
state digest recorded
scenes.action: play two weeks: harvest from a scar, sow on a fresh burn and on watered ash, shelter with a furnace-beast through ash fall; save mid-way while the front walks; reload; let the line pass a second field; second order: sow first and let the fire come to it; switch the mechanics off and on
scenes.expect: the digest after reload equals the one before; the second pass yields fruit again; switches leave nothing behind; log clean

control.case: a reload from a save made before the front lit
control.expect: the digest differs from the mid-way digest
control.rules_out: a reload test that compares two empty states

scenes.restore: a save is made before the walk starts (pre_walk) and every walk save is kept for his review; the walk's colony is disposable and nothing is restored into it; his canonical world saves are never loaded or written

start: clear weather asserted; a live grass burn with ripe scorch-fruit standing in its scar (asserted: fruit count above 0, fire cells on every path to it)
a colonist carrying the firefoam sprayer, health recorded (Firefoam researched)
scenes.action: order the colonist to harvest the scorch-fruit
scenes.expect: the colonist foams a path, picks the fruit and walks back out with no burn injury
scenes.restore: put back the pad terrain, plants, filth and things from the snapshot taken at scene-begin, extinguish every fire the scene lit, remove the foam filth and fruit stacks, restore the colonist's health record

control.case: the same burn and fruit with a colonist without the sprayer
control.expect: the colonist refuses to path through fire or comes back burned
control.rules_out: the fire burning out on its own or the fruit being reachable without crossing fire

start: a colonist holding a shovel
a Pyrelands sand cell and a deep-ash cell, both reachable (asserted by terrain read and path check)
scenes.action: designate both cells; after the dig, designate the dug cell again
scenes.expect: the sand cell yields 5 glass sand and turns to gravel; the dug cell no longer takes the order
scenes.restore: put the dug cell back to sand from the snapshot and remove the glass sand stack

control.case: the deep-ash cell
control.expect: refuses the Shovel sand order
control.rules_out: a dig order that yields glass sand from any ground

start: Pyrelands loaded without PyrelandsMechanics (asserted from the active list), log tap open
a burn under way (asserted: fire clock beat count rising)
scenes.action: let the fire clock tick through a burn
scenes.expect: the log holds nothing from the rite hook
scenes.restore: put back the pad terrain, plants, filth and things from the snapshot taken at scene-begin, extinguish every fire the scene lit, detach the test listener

control.case: the same burn with a test listener attached to PyrelandsFireRiteHook
control.expect: the listener counts one event per fire clock beat
control.rules_out: a hook that is silent because it never raises

start: a wild furnace-beast at low charge (asserted by its CompFurnaceThermalCharge read) beside a grass pad with a live fire
an ullai in the same fire, health recorded
a separate unburned grass pad for its rest, no fire on it (asserted)
scenes.action: read the beast's job, charge and health each hour while it works the burn; move the charged beast to cold ground and read the charge; let it rest on the grass pad and read its bed cells when it wakes
scenes.expect: it walks into the fire and takes no injury while the ullai is burned; charge rises in the burn and falls on cold ground; once full it leaves the burn; its bed cells are alight when it wakes

control.case: the same beast and pads with furnace thermal (furnaceThermalEnabled) switched off
control.expect: the charge stays flat, it does not seek the fire, and its bed never lights
control.rules_out: the burn line lighting the bed or ambient heat moving the charge, rather than the beast's own cycle

scenes.restore: put back the pad terrain, plants, filth and things from the snapshot taken at scene-begin, extinguish every fire the scene lit, despawn the beast and the ullai, restore the furnace thermal switch

start: an ashwallow on the dome pad, conscious and not burrowed (asserted by ProbeDome before the hit)
no fire anywhere on the pad (asserted: fire count 0)
burrow switch and dome switch on
scenes.action: strike the ashwallow once with a Burn hit (heat category, lights nothing); read ProbeDome 5 ticks after, 60 ticks after, and once the hold has run out
scenes.expect: not domed before; domed (RM_Burrowed, job RM_Burrow) within 5 ticks of the hit; the dome graphic drawn at +60; surfaced again after the hold with no fire near

control.case: the same animal and the same Burn hit with the dome switch (burrowDomeOnHeatHit) off
control.expect: no RM_Burrowed and no RM_Burrow job after the hit
control.rules_out: a dome sprite drawn all the time, or an ordinary lie-down or flee reaction to being hurt passing for the dome stance

scenes.restore: despawn the ashwallow, restore the dome and burrow switches; the pad was never lit

start: a pad painted wholly RM_FE_Ash_Deep (asserted: set_terrain changed or already correct on every cell) and grassed with ember grass
clear weather (asserted) and no loose-ash filth on the pad (asserted: count 0)
scenes.action: light the pad and let it burn 2600 ticks; count RM_FE_Filth_LooseAsh on the pad
scenes.expect: at least one loose-ash filth on the burned pad

control.case: the same pad and burn with fire ash-dusting (ashDustingEnabled) off
control.expect: no loose ash on the pad beyond what a pad left unburned beside it banks in the same window
control.rules_out: ambient blowing ash or ash fall banking loose ash on the pad, rather than the fire leaving it

scenes.restore: put back the pad terrain, plants, filth and things from the snapshot taken at scene-begin, extinguish every fire the scene lit, restore the ash-dusting switch and weather

start: a colonist carrying no venom or toxic buildup hediff (asserted), on a cleared pad
a hostile RM_Flamefang beside it
scenes.action: let the flamefang land bites until one connects; read the colonist's hediffs at once and each hour for six hours
scenes.expect: RM_FlamefangVenom present after the bite, its severity rising over the hours

control.case: a fresh colonist bitten by a non-venomous predator of like size
control.expect: a bite wound and no RM_FlamefangVenom
control.rules_out: the venom coming from any bite or melee damage, rather than the flamefang's own bite tool

scenes.restore: despawn the predators, kill or despawn the test colonists, put back the pad from the snapshot taken at scene-begin

start: the giant switch (furnaceBeastGiant) on at load (asserted from the settings read)
a furnace-beast and an ullai spawned on a cleared pad
scenes.action: read the live RM_FurnaceBeast race body size and each life stage's draw size, and both pawns' body sizes
scenes.expect: live body size 6 and the giant draw sizes, the beast more than three times the ullai's 1.8

control.case: RM_PyrelandsGiants' classic restore invoked with the switch off (static call, no reload)
control.expect: live body size back to the classic 3.2 and the classic draw sizes
control.rules_out: a size read that only echoes the XML file, rather than the game's live def that the switch changes

scenes.restore: re-run the giant patch with the switch on so the live defs read giant again, despawn both pawns

coverage_rest.why: scoped out and to be excised; its check is that RM_FE_FirebreakLine is gone and vanilla paving does its job
one built tool; his root names it as the way to the fruit, and a staged harvest through a live burn checks exactly that without a showcase built round it
one dig order on sand, unrelated to the fire; a direct order check is cheaper
an integration seam with nothing to see in play; a log check alone, with a listener control, covers it
the walk switches the mechanics off and on mid-game and the floor's mod_settings line checks every toggle
he approved the art sheet; the floor's art and reads_as lines run on these scenes' captures, and the biome text is read offline
